City of Encinitas
Senior Citizen Commission
AGENDA
TUESDAY, MARCH 15, 2016 -
02:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
Notice of Canceled Meeting
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
At Home Encinitas, City of Encinitas Senior Planner, Michael Strong
4B.
Encinitas Fire Prevention/Safety, City of Encinitas Sr. Deputy Fire Marshal, Kerri Berberet
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES) Each speaker has three (3) minutes to address the Senior Citizen Commission. There are no time donations during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the Clerk. Direction to staff to bring back a future agenda item or provide additional information to answer a question requires consent of at least two Commission Members.
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES Approve the February 16, 2016 regular meeting minutes.
Agenda Item 7. February 16, 2016 Regular Meeting Minutes
8.
ACTION ITEMS
8A.
Senior Citizen Commission Chair and Vice Chair
Elect a chair and Vice Chair to serve one-year terms.
Agenda Item 8A. Elect Commission Chair and Vice Chair
8B.
Senior Awards Program
Select one finalist for the Senior of the Year Award and one finalist for Service to Senior Award by reviewing finalist nomination forms and listening to the nominator's presentation.
Agenda Item 8B. Senior Awards
8C.
Senior Citizen Commission Proposed Meeting Calendar FY 2016-17
Adopt the FY 2016-17 Senior Citizen Commission proposed meeting calendar.
Agenda Item 8C. FY 2016-17 Commission Meeting Calendar
8D.
FY 2015-16 Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan Goals and Outcomes
1) Ad-hoc committees accomplish and report FY2015-16 Senior Citizen Work Plan goal outcomes; and 2) Receive an At Home Encinitas Update and Goal 4 Ad-Hoc Housing Sub Committee final recommendation.
Agenda Item 8D. FY 2015-16 Commission Work Plan
8E.
Senior Citizen Commission Annual Work Plan Review and Goal Setting
Recommend Action: 1) Complete the FY2015-16 Work Plan Review; and 2) Prepare the FY 2016-17 Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan.
Agenda Item 8E. Fy 2016-17 Commission Work Plan
9.

9A.
Senior Center Operations Report
Agenda Item 9A. Senior Center Operations Report
Agenda Item 9A. Attachment A
10.

11.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS Commissioners may add future agenda items with consensus of two or more Commissioners.
12.
COMMISSION REPORTS Roundtable - All Commissioners
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
